answer:
Use **`VectorStoreIndex`**. Load your documents, then build the index with its `from_documents` method. The docs say: "The simplest way to use a Vector Store is to load a set of documents and build an index from them using `from_documents`" [llama_index/docs/src/content/docs/framework/module_guides/indexing/vector_store_index.md].

The example import is "from llama_index.core import VectorStoreIndex" [llama_index/docs/src/content/docs/framework/understanding/rag/indexing/index.md], and the build step is "index = VectorStoreIndex.from_documents(documents)" [llama_index/docs/src/content/docs/framework/understanding/rag/indexing/index.md].
